Audience: every first-time Wisconsin Class D applicant, including permit holders who will meet reversible, reserved and flex lanes in city and highway driving.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the chapter sets the red-light and turn-on-red rules [A01], the yellow passing lines and their exceptions [A04], and the shared center and reversible lane rules [A05].
